expected_source: Literal W3C 3.1 three-vendor wire values and 3.2.3 IDs/sample bit; independent Python regular-expression truth tables for all 128 ASCII bytes. No production roundtrip supplies expected values.

ascii_tables.reproduce: For each i in range(128), concatenate 1 if re.fullmatch(regex,chr(i)) else 0. Embedded test additionally accounts for OWS or an empty comma member before key and valid k@ey tenant syntax.

known_reference_differences: Official Python Tracestate helper permits special@, special@@vendor, and 1special and considers empty state invalid. These conflict with the Recommendation ABNF/empty-header requirement. We follow the Recommendation, not that helper.
No claim of running the entire official network conformance suite.
documented_library_policies: 8192-byte traceparent limit before parsing and carrier trimming; Limit error.

Future opaque suffix only has the required leading dash checked; the entire header additionally must be ASCII HTTP field-value bytes: HTAB or SP..tilde. This is transport policy, not future-field grammar.
512-byte received/combined tracestate budget counts OWS and added commas; reject rather than truncate. The Recommendation says SHOULD propagate at least512, not a universal512 maximum.
Empty/OWS members are ignored;32 counts nonempty key/value entries. The2021 ABNF literal segment count is ambiguous with empty-member reception, so this is an explicit interoperability choice.
Duplicate parent headers invalidate context even when identical. Invalid tracestate is discarded entirely while a valid parent remains.
Parsing/forwarding preserves parent wire/version/flags; child emits00 and sampled-only flags with a different explicitly supplied parent ID.
